 Centellian24 opens first UK pop-up amid flurry of K-beauty activations 
 Camilla Rydzek 30 October 2026 
 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 Linkedin 
 WhatsApp 
 Korean skincare brand Centellian24 has opened its first consumer-facing UK pop-up, a four-day Derma Lab activation with an early Christmas theme at K-beauty retailer MOIDA. 
 The pop-up, which runs from 29 October to 1 November, follows the brand’s UK launch earlier this year.
 The activation centres on the brand’s hero product, the Madeca Cream Time Reverse Set (Merry Winter Edition), which the brand says has already sold more than 120 million units worldwide.
 At the pop-up visitors also have the opportunity to purchase a range of Centellian24 products, including an exclusive Winter Edition gift set with a 30% discount. They will also enjoy exclusive discounts, including 10% of the entire range, which includes pigmentation-focused products and PDRN formulations. Additional gifting opportunities are also available.
 The pop-up is hosted by K-beauty retailer MOIDA, which only opened at Battersea Power Station in 2026.
 Elly Jung, Lead of Global Marketing for Centellian24, commented: “We are delighted to be creating our first consumer-facing pop-up in the UK with MOIDA, one of the leading K-beauty retailers.
 “We look forward to bringing our bestselling formulations to existing brand fans and introducing them to a new audience through our pop-up at MOIDA, a Korean beauty specialty store in London.”
 The pop-up adds to a busy London calendar for Korean brands. This week Beauty of Joseon is taking over How Matcha! cafés in Marylebone and Notting Hill until 1 November. Anua, which also trades heavily on PDRN, ran its first UK pop-up as a Selfridges roadshow across London , Birmingham and Manchester this summer, built around a UK-exclusive PDRN Lip Serum.
